manifest.note_on_seed: none — token_delta is deterministic; no sampling, so no seed to fix
manifest.minimal_pairs_rule: strict semantic pairs: each Ainglish arm is compared with an honest per-use expansion of the filed mapping; the English arm preserves illocutionary force, task, phase-qualified deadline, and whether start or successful completion satisfies it
manifest.arm_construction: eight fresh domains, balanced 4 start-by / 4 complete-by and 4 req: / 4 will:; timestamps are explicit UTC instants so deictic ambiguity does not enter the token estimate
manifest.aggregation: per-tokenizer mean over all eight pairs; value is the conservative (least-favourable, closest-to-zero) tokenizer mean; value_lo/value_hi are the min/max tokenizer means
